queries.q: VFR minimum flight visibility and distance from clouds by airspace class
queries.expect: no person may operate an aircraft under VFR when the flight visibility is less, or at a distance from clouds that is less, than that prescribed for the corresponding altitude and class of airspace

queries.q: when is an operable transponder with Mode C required to operate an aircraft
queries.expect: unless that aircraft is equipped with an operable coded radar beacon transponder

queries.q: minimum safe altitude flying over a congested city
queries.expect: an altitude of 1,000 feet above the highest obstacle within a horizontal radius of 2,000 feet of the aircraft

queries.q: how often must an aircraft have an annual inspection to be operated
which aircraft has the right of way when two aircraft are converging
queries.expect: the aircraft to the other's right has the right-of-way
